location_qualifier: Group Koenig line at La Haye-du-Puits
current_activity: 91st Luftlande Division remnants, with the 243rd and a 265th Kampfgruppe, hold Group Koenig's line in front of the VIII Corps attack at La Haye-du-Puits
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 4 p. 58 and p. 60 (3 July, the first day of the VIII Corps attack): Colonel Eugen Koenig, acting commander of the 91st Division, led Group Koenig "with parts of the 91st, the 265th, and the 243d Divisions on the flanks, and east European volunteers generally holding the center", with about 3,500 effective soldiers; the line used the marshland west of the Prairies Marécageuses de Gorges. Location: the high ground around La Haye-du-Puits, the dataset place La-Haye-du-Puits, with a precision of 5 km. Location approximate: the line ran across the peninsula; the point stands for the sector. Commander: Eugen König; the CMH calls him Colonel (acting commander), the Lexikon commander list has Generalleutnant Eugen König from 10 June 1944. Relationship: the division stays in the LXXXIV Corps relation CR0033.

current_activity: beside the 243rd in the Lessay coastal sector, controlling remnants of the 77th Division and the 265th Kampfgruppe
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 12 p. 227 gives the German order of battle on the morning of 24 July 1944, the day before the Cobra bombardment: the 91st stood beside the 243d near Lessay, with control over remaining elements of the 77th Division and the exhausted kampfgruppe of the 265th Division. Location: near Lessay, the coastal sector. Location approximate: the Green Book gives the sector, not the command post of the unit.
